name: Kezar Stadium, north stand
note: kezar.ts: open concrete stand, Candlestick seats (Wikipedia). OSM building=grandstand drew a barracks.

name: Kezar Stadium, track and field
note: kezar.ts: the red 8-lane track and the marked infield; its oval is paved ground, clear of the park trees. Centred between the stands (OSM grandstands 476260390/1).

name: McLaren Lodge
note: park-buildings.ts: 1896 sandstone lodge, red tile hips with dormers, the loggia and balcony block (Commons: McLarenLodge.jpg).

name: Stow Lake Boathouse
note: park-buildings.ts: the log-sided boathouse under its broad roof, its deck on the lake (Commons: Stow Lake Boathouse.jpg).

name: Kezar Pavilion
note: kezar.ts: 1924 pavilion, olive stucco, tall arched windows, dark corbelled eave (Mapillary on Stanyan).
